Here are a few Google Search options, ranging from broad to more specific, depending on what you're looking for:

**Broader Searches (good for initial brainstorming):**

* **"high margin digital products"**
* **"profitable digital product ideas"**
* **"best digital products to sell with high profit"**
* **"digital product ideas entrepreneur high profit"**

**More Specific Searches (if you have some initial thoughts or constraints):**

* **"passive income digital products high margin"** (if you're interested in the passive aspect)
* **"SaaS product ideas high margin B2C"** (if you're thinking software-as-a-service for consumers)
* **"high profit online course ideas"** (if you're leaning towards education)
* **"digital template ideas high margin"** (if you're considering templates/resources)
* **"membership site ideas high profit niche"** (if you're thinking recurring revenue)

**Searches focused on the "why" behind high margins:**

* **"factors contributing to high digital product margins"**
* **"how to create high margin digital products"**

**Which one to choose depends on your next step:**

* If you're completely open and just want a wide range of ideas, start with the **broader searches.**
* If you have a specific angle in mind (e.g., passive income, subscriptions), use the **more specific searches.**
* If you want to understand the *mechanics* of high margins, use the **"why" searches.**
